ABOUT JECON GROUP

Decades of Mechanical Mastery & Precision Innovation

Bridging 25+ years of heavy mechanical project execution with cutting-edge multi-axis CNC manufacturing, 6kW fiber laser cutting, and precision sheet metal fabrication.

Our Heritage & Evolution

Originally founded in Vadodara as Jalpa Enterprises, Jecon Engineers Pvt. Ltd. established itself as an indispensable mechanical engineering and construction partner for heavy process plants across India. Managing critical shutdown projects, rotary equipment overhauls, and equipment erection for petrochemical complexes, fertilizers, and power stations, Jecon earned a sterling reputation for technical integrity.

To satisfy skyrocketing industry demand for micron-tolerance machined parts and rapid turnaround laser profile cutting, the group established Jecon Engineering Services Pvt. Ltd. — an advanced high-tech manufacturing plant situated in the prime industrial corridor of GIDC Savli, Manjusar (Vadodara).

Micron-Level Precision

Equipped with 5-axis VMC, CMM inspection, and calibrated toolholders to guarantee ±0.005mm tolerances on every part.

Speed & Reliability

6kW fiber laser with dual exchange pallets and extensive raw metal inventory ensures prompt turnaround times.

Engineering Depth

Managed by seasoned mechanical engineers with comprehensive static and rotary machinery background.

End-to-End Synergy

From initial 3D CAD modeling to fabrication, surface treatment, and on-site plant erection.

CORPORATE PEDIGREE & SYNERGY

Backed by 25+ Years of Industrial Excellence

Jecon Engineering Services Pvt. Ltd. is the specialized advanced manufacturing wing of Jecon Engineers Pvt. Ltd. (formerly Jalpa Enterprises) — a premier mechanical contractor trusted by India's largest petrochemical, refinery, power, fertilizer, and gas processing complexes.

PARENT COMPANY
